subject.title: Architecture: reduce import coupling in pi-embedded-runner/attempt.ts (50+ imports) and discord monitor (30 imports)

question: Should this issue be narrowed to the remaining Discord monitor boundary while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/72072 remains canonical for embedded-runner cleanup?
rationale: Current main still supports the architectural concern, but runner ownership now overlaps an active staged RFC and the proposed generic RunContext is not clearly the desired permanent boundary for either subsystem.

options.title: Narrow to Discord
options.body: Keep this issue for the Discord preflight/process boundary and route all embedded-runner restructuring through the RuntimePlan RFC.

options.title: Keep the umbrella
options.body: Retain both areas here but explicitly subordinate the runner acceptance criteria and implementation sequencing to the RuntimePlan RFC.

options.title: Create a Discord tracker
options.body: Move the remaining Discord work into a new focused issue and close this broad umbrella only after that canonical tracker exists.

recommendation.title: Narrow to Discord
recommendation.body: Keep this issue for the Discord preflight/process boundary and route all embedded-runner restructuring through the RuntimePlan RFC.

likelyOwner.reason: They reviewed the issue and have recent history across both affected surfaces, making them the strongest available owner for deciding canonical scope.
